//: D-001: the mainnet programs the local validator runs, and every mainnet account they read. Program IDs come from Meteora's SDK constants (source column); accounts are added only when a simulation shows a program reading them, never guessed. pnpm fixtures:dump reads this file; evidence/fixtures/mainnet-pins.json records what was dumped.

accounts.name: dbc_event_authority
accounts.why: DBC __event_authority PDA (Anchor emit_cpi signer). Exists on mainnet as a system-owned 0-byte account holding dust; every DBC instruction lists it.

accounts.name: dbc_pool_authority
accounts.why: DBC pool_authority (constant address in the DBC IDL; signs vault transfers). System-owned 0-byte account holding lamports on mainnet; listed by every pool instruction.

accounts.name: damm_v2_pool_authority
accounts.why: DAMM v2 pool_authority PDA (seeds ["pool_authority"]); signs DAMM vault transfers. System-owned 0-byte account holding lamports on mainnet.

accounts.name: damm_v2_migration_config_customizable
accounts.why: DAMM v2 config account DBC migrates into for migration_fee_option = 6 (Customizable); passed as the migration's remaining account. Owned by DAMM v2, 328 bytes.
